name: insyncown
description: Sellable Google Drive selective two-way sync for Linux and Windows

scripts.build: node scripts/sync-version.mjs && npm run build -w @insyncown/shared && npm run build -w @insyncown/daemon && npm run build -w insyncown
scripts.build:daemon: npm run build -w @insyncown/shared && npm run build -w @insyncown/daemon
scripts.build:desktop: npm run build -w @insyncown/shared && npm run build -w insyncown
scripts.dev:daemon: npm run build:daemon && npm run start -w @insyncown/daemon
scripts.dev:desktop: npm run build:desktop && npm run start -w insyncown
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @insyncown/shared && npm run typecheck -w @insyncown/daemon && npm run typecheck -w insyncown
scripts.pack:linux: npm run build && node scripts/bundle-daemon.mjs && npm run pack:deb -w insyncown
scripts.pack:deb: npm run build && node scripts/bundle-daemon.mjs && npm run pack:deb -w insyncown
scripts.pack:win: npm run build && node scripts/prepare-windows-pack.mjs && npm run pack:nsis -w insyncown
scripts.pack:nsis: npm run build && node scripts/prepare-windows-pack.mjs && npm run pack:nsis -w insyncown
